text: Cujo, the Cambers' gentle St. Bernard, is [bitten on the nose by a rabid bat|origin|caught from another] while chasing a rabbit into a cave. Donna Trenton, her marriage strained by an affair, drives her young son Tad to the Cambers' rural garage for repairs just as the infection takes hold. When the dog attacks, the Ford Pinto's alternator dies and mother and son are [trapped inside the car|trigger|cut off and trapped] under a hot sun, while Cujo [throws himself again and again at the windows|threat|nature turning on us].
